issue.title: [DOCS] Fix get snapshot status API parameters

labels.name: :Distributed/Snapshot/Restore
labels.description: Anything directly related to the `_snapshot/*` APIs

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
### Changes

* Documents `GET _snapshot/_status` and `GET _snapshot/<repository>/_status`.
* Notes the `<repository>` and `<snasphot>` parameters are optional.
* Removes erroneous mention of the `<snapshot>` parameter supporting the `_current` value.

Closes #81600

Relates to #80931

### Preview
https://elasticsearch_81818.docs-preview.app.elstc.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/master/get-snapshot-status-api.html
